note: What a correct run must do. Sample families are fake; amounts are cents. Cards are matched by kind and a title/id fragment, because offer ids change when the database is re-seeded.

subtle_subscription_savings.note: The subtler learning trap, taken from an offer already in the saved sample data (id 1328): no free-trial or auto-renew words, just savings that only last while a subscription stays active and the price can change. Parents report it, the Coach proposes a rule, a reviewer approves it, the next run blocks it. The other approved offers must stay approved.

duplicate.note: Each purchase line counts once (the table drops repeats of the same receipt line)

no_false_recall.note: Maya's run must not show the Play Yards recall (CPSC 10490) or the Modera Pack N Play pad recall (CPSC 10453): they share words with her purchases but are not the same product

no_terminated_fda.note: Finished (Terminated) FDA recalls never become cards, e.g. a2 Platinum formula H-0891-2026
